src.title: Garlic Parmesan Steak Alfredo Pasta Meal Prep

recipes.title: Garlic Parmesan Steak Bites & Alfredo Pasta

items.i: each salt, pepper, Italian herbs, parsley and smoked paprika

steps: Toss the cubed steak with the salt, pepper, Italian herbs, parsley, garlic powder, smoked paprika and olive oil. Leave 30 minutes for more flavour.
Cook the steak in a little light butter over medium-high heat, about 2 minutes per side, until golden and juicy.
Lower the heat, add the rest of the butter, the garlic and Parmesan and toss for a minute until coated. Set aside.
Cook the pasta in salted water, reserving a little pasta water.
In the same pan, cook the onion and garlic over medium-low heat 5–6 minutes until soft, then add the extra seasoning for a minute.
Add the evaporated milk, cream cheese and Parmesan on low heat and stir until smooth. Let it bubble gently until thick, loosening with pasta water if needed.
Toss the cooked pasta through the sauce, then divide into 4 containers with the steak bites. Freezes well; reheat with a dash of milk.
